I can’t access or modify your calendar (no calendar tools available), so I can’t cancel the events directly. I can, however, confirm details, show the exact scope I need from you, and draft the cancellation notice(s) and step‑by‑step instructions you can paste into your calendar client. Quick summary and questions first:

Summary of the events you described
- Operations Sync — Tuesdays at 09:00 America/Chicago — 12 attendees. Next occurrence: Tuesday 2026‑07‑14.
- Operations Sync — Thursdays at 15:00 America/Chicago — 4 attendees. Next occurrence: Thursday 2026‑07‑16.

Clarification needed before I prepare/craft cancellation text
1) Which event(s) do you want cancelled?
   - A: Cancel the Tuesday 09:00 recurring series only
   - B: Cancel the Thursday 15:00 recurring series only
   - C: Cancel both recurring series
   - D: Cancel only the next occurrence(s) (e.g., just 2026‑07‑14 and/or 2026‑07‑16) rather than the whole series

2) By “starting tomorrow” do you mean “effective 2026‑07‑13 (i.e., cancel all future occurrences on or after that date)”? (If yes, that will remove the upcoming 07‑14 and 07‑16 occurrences.) Or do you mean “cancel the meeting that would next occur tomorrow” (there is no Operations Sync on Monday 7/13)?

3) Do you want attendees notified with a cancellation notice? (Recommended: yes — calendar systems will send attendees a cancellation if you update the series and send updates.)

If you confirm (A/B/C/D) and whether to notify attendees and the effective date (I’ll assume “effective 2026‑07‑13” if you say “starting tomorrow”), I will:
- Draft the calendar cancellation message(s) (subject + body) you can paste into the calendar update or email.
- Give concise step‑by‑step instructions for canceling the series (Google Calendar and Outlook).

Example cancellation templates
A. Cancel entire recurring series (short, professional)
Subject: Cancelled — Operations Sync (weekly)
Body:
Hi all — Effective immediately (cancelling all future occurrences from July 13, 2026 onward), we are cancelling the weekly Operations Sync. I’ll follow up separately if/when we resume or if we need to reschedule. Thanks, [Your Name]

B. Cancel entire recurring series (with reason + next steps)
Subject: Cancelled — Operations Sync (weekly)
Body:
Hello — We are cancelling the weekly Operations Sync (all future occurrences from July 13, 2026 onward) to [reason — e.g., consolidate updates into the weekly leadership briefing / pause for the quarter / reassess cadence]. If you need to raise an urgent ops item, please email the team or reach out to [contact]. I will share any plans to resume or to set an alternative meeting. Apologies for any inconvenience. — [Your Name]

C. Cancel only next occurrence(s)
Subject: Operations Sync — Cancellation for [Date]
